name: Kozakura Hina
source:
Three years younger than Takumi. Miu's friend. The younger twin sister of Kurumi. She quickly took a liking to Takumi, calling him "Takkun-senpai". Hina is somewhat childish and dangerously clumsy. She's also the one that made the cafe's uniforms.

[summarized from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=703617]Getchu[/url]]
